units.source_text: 上午时分，源氏公子来到西殿，对她说道：“看你的样子很懊恼，到底心情如何？

en.t: Late in the morning, Prince Genji came to the west wing and said to her, "You look terribly upset. How are you feeling?

units.source_text: 今天棋也不下了，好寂寞呵！”

en.t: You are not even playing go today. How lonely this is!"

units.source_text: 向帐中张望，但见她将衣服作被头，连头面也遮盖，一动不动地躺着。

en.t: He peered inside the curtains and saw that she had pulled her robes over herself like bedding, even covering her head and face, and lay there without moving.

units.source_text: 侍女们知道不便，都退出去。

en.t: The waiting women sensed that their presence was awkward and all withdrew.

units.source_text: 公子便走近她去，对她说道：“你为什么如此不快？

en.t: The prince then went close to her and said, "Why are you so unhappy?

units.source_text: 想不到你如此不通情理！

en.t: I never imagined you could be so unreasonable!

units.source_text: 众侍女看见了，都诧异呢！”

en.t: If the waiting women saw this, they would all be astonished!"

units.source_text: 把衣服扯开，但见她满身是汗，连额发也湿透了。

en.t: He pulled the robes aside and saw that her whole body was covered in sweat, and even the hair on her forehead was soaked.

units.source_text: 叹道：“啊呀呀，真是不得了！”

en.t: He sighed and said, "Oh dear, this is truly serious!"

units.source_text: 便捏造千言万语来哄骗她。

en.t: Then he invented all sorts of words to coax and deceive her.

units.source_text: 但紫姬真正地痛恨源氏公子，终于一言也不答。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki truly hated Prince Genji, and in the end she did not answer a single word.

units.source_text: 源氏公子恨恨地说：“完了完了！

en.t: Prince Genji said resentfully, "It is over, over!

units.source_text: 你如此固执，我就从此不再见你，我羞死了！”

en.t: If you are going to be this stubborn, I will never see you again from now on. I am mortified!"

units.source_text: 他打开笔砚盒一看，里面并无答诗。

en.t: He opened the writing box and looked inside, but there was no reply poem in it.

units.source_text: 他想：“她全然不懂，真是个小孩子！”

en.t: He thought, "She understands nothing at all. She really is a child!"

units.source_text: 对她看看，觉得非常可爱。

en.t: As he looked at her, he found her very lovely.

units.source_text: 这一日他整天陪伴着她，讲种种安慰的话。

en.t: That day he stayed with her all day, saying many kinds of comforting words.

units.source_text: 但紫姬还是不能开诚解怀。

en.t: But Lady Murasaki still could not open her heart or let go of her resentment.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得她更加可爱了。

en.t: Prince Genji found her even more lovable.
